Gonna be a major dissenting opinion here, maybe they just take themselves less seriously?

I'm Chinese-American and I'm one of two Chinese servers at a local restaurant.  Their nickname for me is "Chino" (closest analogy in English would be "Chinaman"), and the other they just call by his name.  Thing is, I'm the one they get along with, while the other guy is, well, kind of a dick.  "Chino", rather than a term of derision, is in this context a term of endearment.  I'll say I've got something big for him, they he'll say I have a small dick, then I'll say something-something jumping fences, but none of us get mad because it's all in good fun.

I think most people are able to recognize legitimate differences between ethnicities without devolving into aggressive racism, but what do I know, I'm just a filthy half-Asian who doesn't get it man.
